name: Lululemon Athletica
outlook:
What Lululemon Athletica says to expect

  • Third quarter 2026: net revenue and EPSFor the third quarter of 2026, the Company expects net revenue to be in the range of $2.290 billion to $2.320 billion, representing a decline of 10% to 11%. Diluted earnings per share are expected to be in the range of $0.93 to $0.98 for the quarter.
  • Full year 2026: net revenue and EPSFor 2026, the Company now expects net revenue to be in the range of $10.350 billion to $10.500 billion, representing a decline of 5% to 7%. Diluted earnings per share are now expected to be in the range of $9.48 to $9.73 for the year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
